audit_scope: Consensus safety, epoch authority, node fencing, replicated log commit, and split-brain resistance

findings.title: Unauthenticated Monotonic Epoch Advance in Storage Node Tracker
findings.remediation_details: Implemented strict mode in NodeEpochFencingTracker requiring Ed25519 LeadershipCertificate with majority quorum signatures before advancing high-water mark.

findings.title: Unbound and Unsigned Fencing Tokens
findings.remediation_details: Implemented FencedOperationToken binding (epoch, leader_id, request_id, object_id, shard_id, version, payload_sha256_hex) signed with leader Ed25519 key.

findings.title: Absence of Majority Quorum Commit Barrier in WAL Replication
findings.remediation_details: Created ReplicatedLogManager implementing Raft-style commit_index, log indices, terms, and requiring >= 2 of 3 quorum ACKs before commit.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Vote Grants in Quorum State Machine
findings.remediation_details: Created QuorumVoteGrant signed by voter private key verifying epoch, candidate_id, and voter_id.
